title: Editor
intro: In WordPress the Site Editor (Appearance → Editor) is one full-screen app for editing navigation, styles, pages, templates and patterns of a block theme. Backdrop spreads the same jobs over several administration screens, listed here.
wordpress: The Site Editor opens on a preview of the site with a sidebar: Navigation (the menus), Styles (colors, typography), Pages, Templates (the layouts used for single posts, archives, 404…), and Patterns (reusable block arrangements).
backdrop: Backdrop’s Layout module is the closest thing to templates: each layout is a template (Moscone, Boxton, …) with regions and blocks, assigned to paths. Menus are entities of their own; theme settings cover logo and colors; reusable blocks are custom blocks.

sections.heading: Templates → Layouts
sections.text: WordPress templates (Single Posts, Page, Index, 404) correspond to Backdrop layouts: pick a template, place blocks in its regions, assign it to a path or content type.
